title: Harness economics measurement
description: One recorded measurement run, promoted into measurements/ by `just record`. Required top-level keys are checked by `just verify-measurements` and MUST keep these exact names.

schema_version.description: Schema version this file was produced against.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp the measurement run completed, ISO-8601.

harness.description: Which agentic coding harness produced this measurement.

harness_version.description: Version string of the harness CLI (e.g. `claude --version` output).

workload.description: Identifier of the task or task set measured (e.g. a fixture task id like T2, or `all`).

model.description: Model id used for this run, when a single model applies.

variant.description: For A/B runs: identifies both arms being compared. Free-form because the two arms may differ in kind (model id, MCP config path, system-prompt text).

cache_mode.description: cold: reps spaced past the prompt-cache TTL. warm: reps run back-to-back, first rep discarded as a priming run. `mixed` when an A/B run's arms differ in cache mode.

reps.description: One entry per rep actually attempted, INCLUDING invalid and priming reps — never silently dropped, only excluded from aggregates.

valid.description: Whether this rep's answer matched the task's EXPECTED value. Invalid reps stay in reps[] but are excluded from aggregates — see invalid_rep_rate.

priming.description: True only for the discarded first rep of a warm-mode run. Recorded, never counted in aggregates.

arm.description: Which A/B arm produced this rep. Absent on single-config runs.

aggregates.description: Computed only over valid, non-priming reps.

cache_read_share.description: Share of billed input served from cache. Denominator depends on token_semantics: input_excludes_cache_read -> cache_read / (cache_read + cache_creation + input); input_includes_cache_read -> cache_read / input, because input already contains it. Deliberately NOT called a hit rate: uncached input, output and cache creation are not independently available on every surface. Null when cache attributes were absent.

cache_attr_coverage.description: Fraction of spans or reps that actually carried cache attributes. A zero cache_read_share with coverage < 1 means the meter was silent, not that the cache missed -- several Copilot paths hardcode or never read these fields (microsoft/vscode#309207, #308370). Treat coverage < 1 as an unusable measurement, not a frugal one.

invalid_rep_rate.description: Fraction of non-priming reps whose answer did not match EXPECTED. Headline aggregate: a harness that gives up early looks flatteringly cheap unless this is reported alongside cost.

spans.description: Leaf model-call spans counted. Parent rollup spans are excluded -- summing parent and child double-counts (microsoft/vscode#331438).

paired_diff_metric.description: Which per-rep metric the paired difference was taken over.

paired_diff_mean.description: Mean of B-A over pairs where BOTH arms answered correctly.

bootstrap_seed.description: Seed for the bootstrap resampler. Recorded so a reader can re-derive the interval; the shell original used awk's bare srand() and was not reproducible.

invalid_rep_rate_a.description: Per-arm invalid-rep rate. Pooling both arms halves the apparent failure rate of a config that fails in only one, which is exactly the signal an A/B exists to surface.

invalid_rep_rate_b.description: Per-arm invalid-rep rate. Pooling both arms halves the apparent failure rate of a config that fails in only one, which is exactly the signal an A/B exists to surface.

environment.description: Deliberately minimal — no hostname, no username, nothing that identifies the machine or person that ran this.

source_surface.description: Which concrete surface produced this record. `harness` is too coarse: Copilot's VS Code extension, CLI, SDK, usage API and billing report are separate implementations on separate release trains that have disagreed with each other on the same spend. Never aggregate across surfaces.

token_semantics.description: Whether `input_tokens` already contains cache-read tokens. Anthropic excludes them; GitHub Copilot includes them (copilot-sdk#1160). Without this field the same arithmetic double-counts on one vendor and is correct on the other, silently.

billing_basis.description: What the cost figure is denominated in. These are not convertible: a premium-request count has no token breakdown, and AI credits are not USD.

telemetry_version.description: Version of the emitting harness, as the telemetry itself reported it. Copilot's meter changed at VS Code 1.120, 1.121, 1.125, 1.128, 1.129, 1.131, 1.135 and 1.137; records either side of those boundaries are not comparable.
